meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: Claude 会把 224x224 的 H&E 组织瓦片转成 log1p-CPM 的空间基因表达值；可按基因符号查询约 1.9 万个蛋白编码基因，输出与瓦片坐标对应的基因矩阵，并可直接装入 AnnData。
howto.when: 当你需要约 20x、224x224 的 H&E 瓦片的空间基因表达，想按基因符号查询基因而不是固定 panel，或先用 histolab 切图再对整张切片预测时触发。

say.text: 把 source 换成 prott5，再跑一遍这批瓦片
say.note: 换一种基因嵌入视图重新预测

say.text: 用 histolab 切好整张切片后批量预测并拼成 AnnData
say.note: 得到切片级虚拟空间转录组矩阵

howto.what_en: Claude turns 224x224 H&E tiles into spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM. You can query about 19k protein-coding genes by symbol; the output is a tiles-by-genes matrix that loads into AnnData.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need spatial expression for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or run whole-slide prediction after tiling with histolab.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D for this 224x224 tile with DeepSpot-M
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM values aligned with your gene list

say_en.text: Re-run this batch of tiles with source=prott5
say_en.note: Uses a different gene embedding view

say_en.text: Tile a whole slide with histolab, then batch predict into AnnData
say_en.note: Builds a slide-level virtual ST matrix
